Love candy? We’re sharing the latest Amazon Candy Deals to help you satisfy your sweet tooth cravings! Check them out before they’re gone!

Amazon Candy Deals

Looking for candy deals? Amazon has a couple deals you can grab today! Check out these scenarios for the best prices:

Airheads Mini Bars Winter 28 ct – Under $3.40 after eCoupon and S&S or $3 with 5 S&S (Reg $8)

Hershey’s Candy Cane Kisses – $15.55 after eCoupon and S&S or $12.95 with 5 S&S (Reg $17)

It looks like most of the wrappers on these aren’t Halloween themed and could be used for Christmas!

Hershey’s Fruity Variety Mix (120 ct)  – $10.05 after eCoupon (Reg $18)

Hershey’s Fruity Variety Mix (175 ct)  – $15.30 after eCoupon (Reg $24)

Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Bubble Yum 70 ct  – $7.35 after eCoupon (Reg $10)

Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Bubble Yum 390 ct  – $19.30 after eCoupon (Reg $35)

Hershey’s Christmas Candy Mix (32.45 oz)  – $17.75 (Reg $19)

Hershey’s Christmas Candy Mix (70 ct)  – $10

Hershey’s Christmas Kisses – $17.24

Hershey’s Grinch Kisses – $17.24 (Reg $18.59)

Sour Patch Kids Fruits Mix Share Size – $3.95 after eCoupon and S&S

Nerds Variety Mix Candy (90 ct) – $18.85 with S&S or $16.85 with 5 S&S

Is buying candy in bulk cheaper?

If you’re looking for candy for trick or treat or holiday baking, buying in bulk can definitely save you some money.  Be sure to check pricing per piece and not just the ounces in the bag.  Sometimes there’s a BIG difference!

If I stock up on these Amazon candy deals, how long will wrapped candy last?

For a general rule, the higher quality of candy, the longer it will last.  If it is individually wrapped, you can plan on the candy lasting for six to nine months.  This is assuming that it is kept in a dry location at room temperature (nowhere where it gets damp or has extreme temperature swings).

Some candies (like chocolates) can also be frozen if you plan to use them for baking in the future.
